selection_evidence.physical_board: NES Cart Database profile 269 matches PRG CRC 6FA0E650 and CHR CRC 1DDB1C0E and identifies U4 as Sharp MMC3B

submapper.status: legacy iNES has no NES 2.0 submapper; exact physical board evidence selects standard TLROM/Sharp MMC3B behavior

physical_bank_numbering.prg: bank N is PRG-ROM byte range N*0x2000 through N*0x2000+0x1FFF, N=0..15
physical_bank_numbering.chr: bank N is CHR-ROM byte range N*0x0400 through N*0x0400+0x03FF, N=0..127

power_on.policy: never invent deterministic defaults; fixed mappings resolve, dependent mappings return unresolved-power-state until writes establish them

reset.reason: standard NES cartridge connector exposes no dedicated /RESET signal and the MMC3 pinout has no reset input
reset.fixed_vector_access: CPU $E000-$FFFF remains physical PRG bank 15 independent of bank mode

cpu_address_map.read: R6 when $8000.D6=0, fixed bank 14 when D6=1
fixed bank 14 when $8000.D6=0, R6 when D6=1

mirroring.a000_bit0_0: vertical mirroring; CIRAM A10 <- PPU A10
mirroring.a000_bit0_1: horizontal mirroring; CIRAM A10 <- PPU A11
mirroring.header_note: legacy header metadata is not used to invent a guaranteed MMC3 power-on latch value

ram.a001_behavior: MMC3 control bits are latched for state/debugging but no RAM chip exists, so $6000-$7FFF remains open bus

registers.name: bank select
registers.transition: select R0-R7 with D0-D2; D6 immediately selects PRG mode; D7 immediately selects CHR inversion; D3-D5 ignored on MMC3

registers.name: bank data
registers.transition: write selected bank register; R0/R1 ignore D0; R6/R7 ignore D7-D6; board masks select installed ROM capacity

registers.name: nametable arrangement
registers.transition: D0=0 vertical mirroring, D0=1 horizontal mirroring; other bits ignored

registers.name: PRG-RAM protect
registers.transition: D7 chip enable and D6 write protect are electrically meaningful MMC3 outputs, but exact board has no PRG-RAM chip

registers.name: IRQ latch
registers.transition: replace IRQ reload value; does not immediately replace counter

registers.name: IRQ reload
registers.transition: clear counter immediately and request reload on next qualified PPU A12 rise

registers.name: IRQ disable/ack
registers.transition: disable IRQ generation and clear pending external mapper IRQ; counter keeps running

registers.name: IRQ enable
registers.transition: enable IRQ generation without changing counter

irq.clock_source: qualified PPU A12 low-to-high transitions, not host scanlines
irq.clock_rule: if counter is zero or reload pending, load latch; otherwise decrement; then Sharp behavior asserts IRQ whenever resulting counter is zero and IRQ enable is set
irq.latch_zero: can assert on every qualified A12 rise while enabled
irq.c001: clears counter and sets reload pending

production_policy.unknown_power_state: fail closed when an operation depends on a latch not yet established
